luke.description: The Luke instance attached to this component.

parentSelector.description: The parent selector for the diagram legend

spinner.description: The spinner that masks the component when data is loading

renderingSelectors.description:
An array of selectors used to determine whether the page/component exist or is rendered.  These selectors will be searched
for within the {@link #parentSelector}.

timeout.description: The maximum amount of time that Luke will retry an action

legendButtonSelector.description: The CSS selector for the diagram legend button

legendSelector.description: The CSS selector for the diagram legend

linesSelector.description: The CSS selector for the diagram legend lines section

nodesSelector.description: The CSS selector for the diagram legend node section

itemSelector.description: The CSS selector for a diagram legend item

lineItemIconSelector.description: The CSS selector for a diagram legend line item's icon

nodeItemIconSelector.description: The CSS selector for a diagram legend node item's icon

textSelector.description: The CSS selector for a diagram legend item's text
